name: Royal System Partner Price for WooCommerce
author: royalsystem

sections.description:
Royal System Partner Price for WooCommerce lets you sell to your business partners, wholesalers and resellers at a special price while regular customers keep seeing your normal prices.

Partners register on your site, you approve them manually, and from then on they see and pay the partner price automatically in the shop, the cart and at checkout.

The plugin interface and front-end forms are written in Persian (Farsi) and designed for right-to-left sites.

Features

  • One global percentage discount applied to all simple products
  • Partner registration with manual approval by the store manager
  • Login and registration with a mobile number
  • Password reset that only works for approved partners
  • Private partner dashboard with order history and order details
  • Show the regular price and the partner price together, or the partner price only
  • Price rounding with adjustable precision
  • Partner management screen: approve, reject, edit, delete, search and filter, plus a provinces map
  • Out-of-stock products hide their price and the add to cart button
  • Smart login/account button shortcode for headers, footers and page builders

Shortcodes

  • [partner_auth] – combined partner login and registration form (page slug must be auth)
  • [partner_dashboard] – partner dashboard (page slug must be dashboard)
  • [partner_auth_button] – smart login/account button

The two pages are created automatically on activation.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the Plugins screen, then activate it.
  3. Open the “Partner Price” menu and set the partner discount percentage.
  4. Approve new partners from the “Partners” screen.
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin only works together with WooCommerce.

Do variable products get a partner price?

No. Partner prices are currently applied to simple products.

Can an unapproved partner see partner prices?

No. Pending and rejected partners cannot log in or access partner prices.
